faq.controlA: You do. HASHPASS is non-custodial: your wallet is encrypted with your PIN and your seed never leaves your device unencrypted. HASHPASS cannot move, freeze or recover your assets, and is not responsible for their management or security.
faq.pinA: The PIN encrypts your wallet. It is asked every time you open your wallet and before every sensitive action. HASHPASS cannot see or recover it — if you forget it, use the email code + recovery phrase reset.
faq.phraseA: Twenty-four words that fully back up your wallet. Write them down in order and keep them private: anyone who has them controls your funds. If you lose them, your funds cannot be recovered.
faq.forgotQ: I forgot my PIN. What now?
faq.forgotA: Open your wallet page and choose "I forgot my PIN". A six-digit code is emailed to you; the code plus your saved recovery phrase sets a new PIN and rebuilds your wallet.
faq.importQ: Can I import my existing wallet?
faq.importA: Not at the moment. For your security HASHPASS only manages wallets it creates itself, and never handles recovery phrases from other wallets. You can export your own recovery phrase at any time from the wallet menu.
faq.networksA: Ethereum, Bitcoin and Solana first. The rollout runs on test networks; main networks arrive after the security review is complete.
faq.testnetA: During the rollout your HASHPASS wallet is created on test networks, so balances are test balances. Your account, PIN and recovery phrase work the same way on main networks later.
faq.supportA: For account or event questions, contact HASHPASS support. For anything about your funds, remember: only your PIN and recovery phrase control the wallet — support can never move assets for you.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.text: HASHPASS ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our digital event platform and services (the "Service"). Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the Service.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.text:
We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

• Account Information: Your name and email address, whether you sign in with Google, with an email verification code, or with a linked cryptocurrency wallet.
• Profile Photo: If you choose to upload a profile picture, we store and display it. This is optional.
• Wallet Information: If you connect a cryptocurrency wallet (e.g. Solana or Ethereum) to sign in, we collect and store your public wallet address. We never collect or have access to your private keys or seed phrase.
• Messages: If you use in-app messaging, we store sender and recipient identifiers, timestamps, and message content so messages can be delivered and displayed. Content sent through a scheduled meeting's chat is end-to-end encrypted; content sent through general event chat and direct messages between attendees is not — see Section 5 for details.
• Event Data: Information about events you attend, passes you hold, and interactions within our platform.
• Usage Data: Information about how you use our Service, including features accessed and actions taken.
• Device Information: Technical information about your device, browser, and operating system.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.text:
We use the information we collect to:

• Provide and maintain our Service
• Process your event registrations and manage your passes
• Send you important updates about events and services
• Improve and personalize your experience
• Detect and prevent fraud or abuse
• Comply with legal obligations

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.text:
We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with third parties for their own independent purposes. We use a small number of service providers who process data solely on our behalf, under contract, to help us operate the Service:

• Supabase, for authentication and database hosting
• Brevo, to deliver transactional emails such as sign-in verification codes
• AWS S3 and CloudFront, to host and deliver event and profile images

We may also share your information:

• With event organizers for events you register for
• When required by law or to protect our rights
• In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.text:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information:

• Encryption in transit: All data sent between your device and our servers is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS.
• End-to-end encrypted meeting chat: Messages you send through a scheduled meeting's chat are end-to-end encrypted (X25519 key exchange, HKDF-SHA256, and XChaCha20-Poly1305) directly on your device — only you and the recipient can read that content, HASHPASS cannot access it. General event chat and direct messages between attendees are not end-to-end encrypted and are stored as regular text.
• Account deletion: You can permanently delete your account and associated personal data at any time from within the app.

No method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.text:
You have the right to:

• Access your personal information
• Correct inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your information
• Object to processing of your information
• Data portability
• Withdraw consent at any time
rights.deleteAccountLink: You can delete your account and data at any time — see how →

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.text:
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to maintain your session, remember preferences, and analyze usage of our Service. Cookies we use include:

• Essential cookies: required for authentication and security (session tokens, CSRF tokens).
• Analytics cookies: set by Google Analytics to measure how visitors interact with our website (see Section 8).

You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to notify you when a cookie is being sent. Disabling essential cookies will prevent you from signing in.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.text: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.text:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: privacy@hashpass.tech
Website: https://hashpass.tech

analytics.title: 8. Analytics Services (Google Analytics)
analytics.text:
We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), a web analytics service provided by Google LLC ("Google"), to help us understand how visitors use our website.

What Google Analytics collects:
• Pages visited and time spent on each page
• Browser type, operating system, and device type
• Approximate geographic location (country/city level)
• Referral source (how you arrived at our site)
• Events and interactions (e.g. button clicks, form submissions)

IP anonymization: We have enabled IP anonymization (anonymize_ip: true), so your full IP address is never stored or processed by Google.

Data transfer: Google processes analytics data on servers located in the United States. Google LLC is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, providing adequate safeguards for data transfers from the European Economic Area.

Data retention: Analytics data is retained for 14 months, after which it is automatically deleted.

Your choices:
• Browser opt-out: Install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout
• Do Not Track: We honor browser Do Not Track signals — when DNT is enabled, no analytics data is collected.

Google's privacy policy is available at https://policies.google.com/privacy

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing and using HASHPASS ("the Service"), you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

description.title: 2. Service Description
description.text: HASHPASS is a digital event platform that provides event management, pass management, networking features, and related services. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the Service at any time.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.text:
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to:

• Provide accurate and complete information
• Keep your account information updated
• Not share your account with others
• Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use
• Accept responsibility for all activities under your account

If you choose to sign in by linking a cryptocurrency wallet, you are solely responsible for the security of your wallet, private keys, and seed phrase. We never request, collect, or have access to your private keys or seed phrase, and we cannot recover a wallet-linked account if you lose access to your wallet.

conduct.title: 4. User Conduct
conduct.text:
You agree not to:

• Violate any laws or regulations
• Infringe on intellectual property rights
• Transmit harmful code or malware
• Harass, abuse, or harm other users
• Collect user data without permission
• Impersonate others or provide false information
• Interfere with the Service's operation

content.title: 5. User Content
content.text:
You retain ownership of content you submit to the Service. By submitting content, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute your content for the purpose of providing and improving the Service.

Messages you send through our in-app meeting chat feature are end-to-end encrypted and readable only by you and the recipient (see our Privacy Policy for details) — this license to message content is limited accordingly, since we cannot access or process encrypted message content ourselves.

intellectual.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectual.text: The Service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by HASHPASS and are protected by international copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and other intellectual property laws.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.text: We may terminate or suspend your account and access to the Service immediately, without prior notice, for any reason, including if you breach the Terms. Upon termination, your right to use the Service will cease immediately.

disclaimer.title: 8. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.text: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. We do not warrant that the Service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.

limitation.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
limitation.text: In no event shall HASHPASS be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or use, incurred by you or any third party, whether in an action in contract or tort.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Learn how to sign in and navigate the app

signIn.title: Sign In to Your Account
signIn.content: To get started, you'll need to sign in to the HASHPASS app. Open the app, enter your email address, check your email for a one-time login code, and enter the code to access your account.

explore.title: Explore Speakers & Events
explore.content: Once you're signed in, you can browse through the amazing speakers and events. Navigate to the Explore section, browse speakers by category or search for specific names, and view speaker profiles, topics, and availability.

requestMeeting.title: Send a Meeting Request
requestMeeting.content: Ready to connect with a speaker? Find a speaker you'd like to meet, tap on their profile to view details, click the "Request Meeting" button, select your preferred date and time slot, add a message (optional), and submit your request.

trackRequests.title: Track Your Requests
trackRequests.content: Keep track of all your meeting requests. Check the Notifications section for updates, view pending, accepted, or declined requests, and receive notifications when speakers respond.

loadingIssues.title: Having Issues Loading the Web App?
loadingIssues.content: If you're experiencing problems loading the web app, we recommend clearing your browser cache or performing a hard refresh.
loadingIssues.step1: Clear browser cache: Go to your browser settings and clear cached images and files
loadingIssues.step2: Hard refresh: Press Ctrl+Shift+R (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Shift+R (Mac) to reload the page without cache

loginIssues.title: Login Problems
loginIssues.content: If you're having trouble logging in, make sure you're using the correct email address and check your spam folder for the login code. If the code has expired, request a new one.

meetingIssues.title: Meeting Request Issues
meetingIssues.content: If your meeting requests aren't being sent or received, check your internet connection, ensure you're signed in, and verify that the speaker has availability during your selected time slot.

specificRequests.title: Be Specific in Meeting Requests
specificRequests.content: Speakers appreciate knowing what you'd like to discuss. Be specific in your meeting request message to increase the chances of acceptance.

checkAvailability.title: Check Speaker Availability
checkAvailability.content: Before sending requests, check the speaker's availability calendar to ensure they're free during your preferred time slot.

respondPromptly.title: Respond Promptly
respondPromptly.content: When a speaker accepts your meeting request, respond promptly to confirm your meeting and show your commitment.

useSearch.title: Use the Search Function
useSearch.content: Use the search function to find speakers by topic, company, or name. This will help you quickly find the right people to connect with.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to permanently delete your HASHPASS account and what happens to your data when you do. It works whether or not you have the HASHPASS app installed or are signed in.

steps.title: How to Delete Your Account
steps.text:
If you have access to your account:

1. Open the HASHPASS app.
2. Sign in to your account.
3. Go to Dashboard → Settings.
4. Scroll down and tap "Delete Account".
5. Confirm that you understand this is permanent.
6. We'll email a verification code to your account's email address — enter it to confirm.
7. Your account and data are deleted immediately.

noAccess.title: Can't Access Your Account?
noAccess.text: If you've lost access to the app or your account, email privacy@hashpass.tech from the email address associated with your HASHPASS account, with the subject "Account Deletion Request". We'll verify your identity and delete your account manually.

deleted.title: What Data Is Deleted
deleted.text:
When you delete your account, we immediately and permanently delete:

• Your name, email address, and profile photo
• Your linked cryptocurrency wallet address, if any
• Your event passes and pass requests
• Your meeting requests (sent and received), meetings, and messages you sent or received in meeting chat, event chat, and direct messages
• Your networking status, agenda, and tutorial progress
• Blocked-user relationships
• Your account credentials and ability to sign in

retained.title: What Data May Be Retained
retained.text:
A limited amount of data may be retained after your account is deleted:

• Records we are required to keep for legal, tax, accounting, or fraud-prevention purposes, such as token transaction history
• Data that may persist in routine backups for a limited period before being purged
• Messages you sent to other users may remain in the recipient's own copy of the conversation. Content sent through a scheduled meeting's chat is end-to-end encrypted, so HASHPASS cannot read it regardless of retention; content sent through general event chat or direct messages is not encrypted

Any retained data is used only for the purposes listed above and is handled according to our Privacy Policy — we do not use it to keep operating your account or profile.

contact.title: Questions
contact.text:
If you have questions about deleting your account or your data, contact us at:

Email: privacy@hashpass.tech
Website: https://hashpass.tech
